messages:
emma.ng: Heads-up — follow-ups from last week's EU failover postmortem. We need to lock owners, timelines, and identify any recurring patterns before next game day. I'll list the items I have so far.

raj.patel: thanks emma. can you paste the short list here? I'll take ownership of routing policy changes if needed.

emma.ng: tl;dr items:
1) restore-runbook gaps — fill missing steps for partial-zone restores (owner: lisa-h, ETA: 2025-04-02)
2) S3 backup verification automation — daily checksum + alert (owner: matt_ops, ETA: 2025-03-28)
3) multi-region routing hysteresis tuning — reduce flaps during failback (owner: raj.patel, ETA: 2025-04-05)
4) recurring pattern analysis — build a dashboard for 3-week spike correlation (owner: kyle_oncall, ETA: 2025-04-09)

lisa-h: I can start a PR for the runbook today. question: do we want explicit steps for restoring partial KV caches? current runbook only covers full-region restore.

matt_ops: yep add a 'partial cache' section. for S3 checksums I'll wire up a lambda cron to run a prefix checksum and post results to #incidents. draft ETA still 3/28.

raj.patel: SGTM for routing hysteresis. propose: increase route-stable-window from 30s -> 90s and add a canary in eu-west-1 before global change. anyone opposed?

kyle_oncall: no objections. I'll add a Grafana panel for routing flaps and tie an alert to the incident cadence board. curious if the pattern correlates with snapshot restores.

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-2025-334 created: EU failover postmortem follow-ups. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2025-334

emma.ng: pls add these as separate cards on the remediation board and tag with 'game-day' and 'postmortem'. Also schedule a mini game day dry-run week of 2025-04-14.

raj.patel: I'll own the first canary rollout plan. leaving a short snippet for the canary steps:
```
# canary rollout plan
1) update route-hysteresis in eu-west-1 canary
2) monitor 30m for flaps/latency
3) if stable, roll to other regions in 15m increments
4) fallback plan: roll back within 5m if >2% error increase
```

lisa-h: PR created for runbook: https://git.example/r/runbooks/pulls/54 — please review.

matt_ops: S3 checksum lambda deployed to staging. will enable prod after one successful run. posting results to #incidents once green.

kyle_oncall: added dashboard panels and linked to INC-2025-334. discovered recurring spikes every ~36–40 hours aligned with nightly compact jobs — adding that to the root cause candidate list.

emma.ng: great. owners — confirm you added issues and set deadlines on the board. I'll run the dry-run invite thread tomorrow. :eyes:

raj.patel: confirmed, added. tagging @platform-eng for any infra changes.

matt_ops: confirmed.

lisa-h: confirmed. starting documentation review now.

kyle_oncall: confirmed. I'll also create a weekly query to detect the 36–40h spikes and send a weekly digest to the remediation board.

emma.ng: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the canary (ETA 2025-04-05) to close outstanding items or extend timelines as needed. :thumbsup:
